column1: # Super Smash Bros. Ultimate 13.0.5. Bring-up profile; gameplay is not yet validated.
# Identity/builds measured from the player's base XCI plus cumulative update.
# Preserve the game's composition until both camera and HUD can be corrected.
# Main references save:/save_data/system_data.bin. Require this progress file
# before publishing a whole committed snapshot; verify its live creation at boot.
# Main's allocator reserves 0xf80000000 (62 GiB) of virtual address space at
# main+0x37c9a58. This is sparse address space, not resident physical memory.
# Leave room for SDK address-region bookkeeping plus the normal physical heap.
